feat(collector): the host judges each shell and file run where it is declared, and a refusal is the run's standing fault (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.jmi)

The loader parses a source's path, regex and ttl and no longer judges them.
SourceRuns.declare judges every run (an absolute file.path and
cache.watch_file, a regex that compiles with a capture group, a shell ttl
at least the floor), so the collector and check's holder judge alike. An
accepted run is the only thing the readers take; a refused one is held as
an entry that reads nothing and answers failed, and its lane's fault says
why. The registry turns every source's run fault, not only watch_file's,
into the variable's standing fault, so a refusal reaches the bar's warning
indicator and check's verdict through the refresh warning. A shell ttl
below the floor is refused, not silently clamped. The schema drops its
"^/" patterns.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.219.2
